notes: Ending illustration, 320x180 per frame, 4 frames looping at 3 fps. Draw it at 3x or 4x with nearest filtering; add the glow strip over it (additive). Light comes from the top-left. A convoy of mismatched ships (Clan hauler, Concord frigate, Lumen skiff, a welded liner, a tug, a raft, darts) arrives at Halcyon, its dome glowing warm. Frames: exhaust flicker, the approach beacons walk in, windows and stars twinkle.
